name: Echo the Dark
description: The ghost speaks its own name into the void.

name: Count the Letters
description: Measure the length of a sacred word.

name: The Repeating Whisper
description: A chant repeated three times, as spirits do.

name: Pattern Seeker
description: Find the first vowel lurking in the word GHOST.
source:
SUBJECT = 'GHOST'
        SUBJECT ANY('AEIOU') . FOUND
        OUTPUT = FOUND
END

name: String Reversal Ritual
description: Reverse a word, as the spirit world mirrors ours.
source:
S = 'SNOBOL'
        R = ''
LOOP    S LEN(1) . C = '' :F(DONE)
        R = C R :(LOOP)
DONE    OUTPUT = R
END

name: Arithmetic of the Ancients
description: Sum the year of creation: 19 + 67 = the year SNOBOL4 was born.
source:
A = 19
        B = 67
        OUTPUT = A + B
END

name: The Fibonacci Séance
description: Summon the first eight numbers of the Fibonacci sequence.
source:
A = 0
        B = 1
        COUNT = 0
LOOP    OUTPUT = A
        C = A + B
        A = B
        B = C
        COUNT = COUNT + 1
        LT(COUNT, 8) :S(LOOP)
END

name: Speak the Name
description: A second tongue, the same word: the ghost names itself in Forth.

name: Measure the Word
description: Count the letters of a sacred word, stack-first.

name: The Threefold Chant
description: A chant repeated three times by a DO LOOP, not a string function.

name: The Overflow Specter
description: Push a 32-bit integer past its limit and watch it wrap into darkness.

name: The Fibonacci Séance (Forth)
description: The same eight numbers, summoned by a stack instead of variables.
source:
: FIB 0 1 8 0 DO OVER . TUCK + LOOP 2DROP ;
FIB
